goal: One paragraph: what is being delivered and why it matters to the people who asked for it.

requirements.statement: State one requirement in a single sentence.
requirements.acceptance: State how a reviewer can tell this requirement is met.

constraints.statement: SIMPLE-CODE-GATE v2 applies to all code-changing work in this run.

scope_in: Name each area, file group, or behaviour that is in scope.
scope_out: Name each adjacent area that is explicitly out of scope.

verification_requirements.description: Name the check that proves R-001; its id must match the verification manifest.

risks.statement: Name a way this run could fail.
risks.mitigation: Name what prevents or detects it.

done_definition: Every requirement row in the Statement of Completion is verified or carries a human decision.
